ringBuilder.metaTitle: 3D Ring Builder – Design Your Own Engagement Ring Online
ringBuilder.metaDescription: Design your own diamond engagement ring in 3D. Choose the shape, carat, setting and gold, rotate it 360° and get a quote. Certified diamonds, handcrafted in Surat.
ringBuilder.keywords: ring builder, 3D ring builder, design your own engagement ring, custom engagement ring builder, lab grown diamond ring builder, build your own ring online, custom diamond ring designer
ringBuilder.title: Design your own
ringBuilder.intro: Build a one-of-a-kind diamond ring in real-time 3D. Pick the diamond shape, carat, band, setting and gold, turn it 360° from every angle, then send it to our team for a quote. Free to use, no sign-up.

steps.title: Choose your diamond
steps.text: Start with the centre stone: nine shapes from round to marquise, from 0.50 to 3.00 carats.

steps.title: Style the ring
steps.text: Pick the band, the side setting and the halo, then choose white, yellow or rose gold in 14K or 18K.

steps.title: See it in 3D
steps.text: Rotate your ring 360° and check it from the front, side, top and angle views before you decide.

steps.title: Get your quote
steps.text: Tap “Enquire for price”. We send a quote, certified lab-grown or natural stone options and CAD renders for approval.

ringBuilder.featuresTitle: Why design your ring with Starlink

features.title: Certified diamonds
features.text: Lab-grown or natural centre stones graded by IGI or GIA, with the certificate shared before dispatch.

features.title: Approve before we craft
features.text: You see detailed CAD renders of your exact design and approve every detail before anything is made.

features.title: Handcrafted in Surat
features.text: Cast, set and polished by master artisans in Surat, the diamond capital of the world, since 2011.

features.title: Insured worldwide delivery
features.text: Fully tracked and insured shipping, complimentary on orders over $500.

faq.question: What is the Starlink Ring Builder?
faq.answer: It is a free online 3D ring designer. You choose the diamond shape and carat, the band style, side setting, halo and gold, see the ring in real-time 3D, and send the design to our team for a quote.

faq.question: Is the ring builder free to use?
faq.answer: Yes. Designing your ring is completely free and needs no account. You only pay if you decide to order the ring.

faq.question: Can I choose a lab-grown or a natural diamond?
faq.answer: Yes. After you send your design we share certified lab-grown and natural diamond options that match your chosen shape and size, so you can compare before deciding.

faq.question: Which diamond shapes and settings can I pick?
faq.answer: Round, princess, oval, pear, emerald, radiant, marquise, heart and elongated cushion diamonds from 0.50 to 3.00 carats, six band styles, plain gold, pavé, prong or channel side settings, and no halo, a hidden halo or a single halo.

faq.question: Which metals are available?
faq.answer: White, yellow and rose gold in 14K or 18K. Ask our team if you would like another metal.

faq.question: How do I get the price of my ring?
faq.answer: Tap “Enquire for price” in the ring builder or contact us on WhatsApp. We reply with a quote, certified stone options and CAD renders of your design.

faq.question: Can I change my design after I send it?
faq.answer: Yes. You approve the CAD renders before crafting begins, so size, stone or setting changes can be made at that stage.

faq.question: Do you ship my ring worldwide?
faq.answer: Yes. Every ring is shipped fully insured with tracking, and shipping is complimentary on orders over $500. Your delivery date is confirmed on WhatsApp before we begin.

ringBuilder.finalText: It takes a few minutes. Our experts are on WhatsApp if you want help choosing.

faq.question: What is the Starlink 3D jewelry viewer?
faq.answer: It is a free, real-time 3D viewer for fine jewelry. You can rotate a piece 360°, zoom in and switch between gold, platinum and silver finishes, with realistic diamond refraction.

faq.question: Do I need to install any software?
faq.answer: No. The viewer runs in your web browser on phone, tablet or desktop. There is nothing to download or install.

faq.question: Is the 3D view photorealistic?
faq.answer: The viewer renders each piece in real time with studio lighting and true diamond refraction, so the metal and the stones react to light as you turn them.

faq.question: Which metal finishes can I compare?
faq.answer: Gold, platinum and silver finishes, switched live in the viewer.

faq.question: Can I buy a piece I see in 3D?
faq.answer: Yes. Contact our team on WhatsApp for the price, certified stone options and delivery details. Every piece is made to order.

faq.question: Can jewellers get renders of their own designs?
faq.answer: If Starlink is manufacturing your designs, we share detailed CAD renders for you to approve before production. Contact our team to discuss your project.

viewer.finalTitle: See it before you buy it
viewer.finalText: Open the viewer, or design a ring of your own in our 3D Ring Builder.
